body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2005') -- <Visual News> JIUM(www.e-jium.com) has introduced its new cooler for laptop ‘Cycooler’. When you place your lap top on ‘Cycooler’, thermoelement on the surface of the laptop absorbs heat and then releases by adhering to the base of the laptop. By employing electronic cooling system, it increased the contact surface to release heat more efficiently. Users can choose a mode from low-noise mode or high-function mode. Its ergonomic design helps to mitigate your wrist pain. It is wide enough to be compatible with 12” ~ 17” wide laptop and contains 4 USB ports. <AVING Special Report Team for ‘KES2005’ : Editor&Publisher, Jason Lee, Joshua Shim, Nikki Whang, Sheri Choi, Sophia Kwag, Annie Park, Caleb Ma, edited by Daniel Sirh>
